channel.title: Off Road Xtreme - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Off Road Xtreme (offroadxtreme.com)

item.title: Easily Run 35s On A Jeep Wrangler With This Bilstein B8 5100 Lift Kit
item.description: Fit 35s with the Bilstein B8 5100 Lift Kit. This 1.5-inch system maintains factory geometry and improves off-road travel.

item.title: 1973 Chevy Crew Cab: Pre-Digital Cummins-Swapped Iron Built To Survive An EMP Attack
item.description: This Cummins-powered 1973 Chevrolet Crew Cab 4x4 pickup is built to be a rugged, EMP-resistant, mechanically simple diesel workhorse.

item.title: 2026 Jeep Gladiator Whitecap: A Heritage Mission Built For The Trail
item.description: The 2026 Jeep Gladiator Whitecap debuts as a heritage-inspired special edition with bold two-tone styling starting at just $495.

item.title: The 2026 Ram Rebel X: Twin-Turbo Torque Meets Trail Tech
item.description: The 2026 Ram 1500 Rebel X returns with 420-hp Hurricane power, exclusive Rough Road Cruise Control, and premium tech starting at $71,930.

item.title: TMI Products Expands Into Late-Model Trucks, SUVs, And Jeeps With Premium Leather Upholstery
item.description: TMI Products launches a premium upholstery line for trucks, SUVs, and Jeeps, offering factory-fit quality with airbag-tested safety.

item.title: A Wild Suspension Upgrade For Whistlindiesel’s Massive Twin-Engine Monstermax Chevy Silverado
item.description: Tyler Fever rebuilds the Monstermax suspension using custom parts. The 40,000-lb truck now features massive nitrogen shocks.

item.title: 1972 Chevy K5 Blazer: From Rusty Survivor To Dialed LS3-Swapped Restomod
item.description: This 1972 Chevy K5 Blazer was just another aging, run-of-the-mill SUV. That changed when Adams Customs restored the rig and added a LS3 V8.

item.title: 2025 Ford F-550 Overkill Judgment: Six Doors, 43s, And Zero Chill
item.description: This six-door 2025 Ford F-550 4x4 turbodiesel is more than a pretty face. It has a multifunctional tray bed, smooth-riding suspension, more.

item.title: From The Outback To The Backcountry: The History Of GME And Its Expansion Into The United States
item.description: Explore the history of Australia’s GME Radios and its expansion into the U.S. off-road and overland market.

item.title: This Turbodiesel 1946 Dodge Power Wagon Packs 900 lb-ft Of Torque
item.description: This 1946 Dodge Power Wagon 4x4 has been custom built from the ground up. Features include four doors and a potent Cummins turbodiesel.
